description.zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口[ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~)或[ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~)获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation to query the task flow ID.

description.zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见[查看租户信息](~~181330~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the tenant.

> : To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~).

title.zh: 获取超时规则最小调度周期

descriptions.zh: 设置SLA规则时，任务流的调度周期需要大于SLA规则数量限制。
descriptions.en: The scheduling cycle of a task flow must be greater than the minimum scheduling cycle configured in the SLA rule for the task flow.
